The whole-definition OE001 schema ledger has 26914 exact kills and 10683 INVALID proposals over 20 real check_schema sites, plus 26891 exact kills from path-novel controls beyond the per-site cap; every reachable clause is witnessed with OE001 cut and restoration, witnessed at the same site in another family with identical schema pins, or vacuous (vacuous 16, witnessed 1924, witnessed_supplement 33); keyword independence is not claimed. Lane-wide copy-join inventory, 193 two-copy rows: 91 have each copy changed alone and refused first there, 76 have the second copy located and pinned by named earlier joins (checked), 24 carry written dispositions (derived, configuration or legacy-callback copies) and 2 are by-construction rows. Retained reads select only the sealed original store and leave it unchanged (34/34 exact). Shared numbers and date-time profiles run at every DCW boundary (EventRecord; storage_utc_z for Storage-assigned times; acknowledged_at_utc EventRecord per E5-2).
